evals.name: absurd-template-scanning
evals.prompt: Our absurd_templates app's Tailwind build misses utilities that appear only in HTML. abs.yaml sets input lib/src/ui/templates and output lib/generated/html.dart. input.css is at the root and currently scans lib/**/*.dart. Fix scanning, excluding generated output but retaining Dart class variants. Explain where the stylesheet belongs and how CSS and abs builds relate.
evals.expected_output: Explicit HTML plus non-generated Dart scanning, layout stylesheet link, independent CSS/template builds and verification with a template-only utility.
assertions: Registers lib/src/ui/templates/**/*.html and lib/**/*.dart with paths relative to root input.css
Excludes lib/generated output and does not use it as the source of template classes
Places the stylesheet in the shared layout rather than HTMX partials
Explains that Tailwind reads HTML directly and needs no prior abs generation, while production needs both builds
Does not add a renderer, frontend bundler, or runtime Tailwind script

evals.name: jaspr-mode-assets
evals.prompt: Add Tailwind to an existing Jaspr static app. Components are in lib/, static assets in web/, no local npm project. Give the CSS entrypoint and build/watch commands and explain stylesheet placement and production build order. Do not create a second asset pipeline.
evals.expected_output: Jaspr-specific source and document/asset conventions with the shared CLI workflow.
assertions: Scans Dart components and generates CSS into the existing web asset convention
Loads CSS once via the existing document/entrypoint and builds before Jaspr asset packaging
Does not introduce package.json, a bundler, or a hydration-specific Tailwind runtime

evals.name: htmleez-layout
evals.prompt: Our Relic backend uses htmleez 1.0 in lib/views and serves public/index.css at /index.css. Tailwind CLI already works. Show how to add the stylesheet to the shared page and ensure conditional button utilities get scanned. HTMX partials should keep working.
evals.expected_output: htmleez stylesheet link in the shared head, scanning complete Dart utility alternatives, no links in partials or new dependencies.
assertions: Uses htmleez link with explicit rel and href attributes in the shared head
Keeps complete conditional utility strings in scanned Dart source
Does not add stylesheet links to partials, another renderer, or new CSS tooling
